v7-21.candidate: I saw among the spoil a beautiful patterned carpet, two hundred didrachms of silver, and one tongue-shaped bar of gold weighing fifty didrachms. I coveted them and took them. Behold, they are hidden in the ground in my tent, and the silver is hidden underneath them.”

v7-24.candidate: Joshua took Achar son of Zerah and brought him up to the ravine of Achor, with his sons, his daughters, his calves, his beasts of burden, all his sheep, his tent, and everything belonging to him. All the people were with him, and he brought them up to Emek-achor.

v9-2b.candidate: as Moses, the servant of the Lord, commanded the sons of Israel, as written in Moses’ law: an altar of whole stones on which no iron had been applied. He offered whole burnt offerings to the Lord there and a sacrifice of deliverance.

v9-8.candidate: They said to Joshua, “We are your household servants.” Joshua said to them, “Where are you from, and where have you come from?”

v9-11.candidate: When our elders and all the inhabitants of our land heard, they told us, ‘Take provisions for the journey, go to meet them, and say to them, “We are your household servants; now make a covenant with us.”’
